content: The Overview section provides a detailed list of topics included in the resident survival guide project. It also explains how to select a topic for contribution. Additionally, this section allows contributors to update the status of their chosen topic by entering authorship details, ensuring that their work does not overlap with that of other editors. To Select a Topic, contributors should choose a topic from the list of resident survival guide topics provided below. Topics that have already been completed or are currently being worked on by Wikidoc scholars are marked in blue. Topics displayed in black are still available for contribution by scholars, whether they are on campus or collaborating remotely. The List of All Topics includes the following categories: Cardiology Pulmonology Gastroenterology Nephrology Hematology-Oncology Infectious Diseases Endocrinology Rheumatology and Immunology Immunology Neurology Miscellaneous Primary Care Toxicology
